C0394.title: Illegal Acquisition of Personal Data to Run an 'Account Farming Factory'
C0394.summary: Police in Yingtan, Jiangxi, uncovered a case involving infringement of citizens' personal information. The suspect surnamed Xu allegedly bought more than ten million real-name email accounts and passwords, used automated scripts to farm game accounts, and sold the matured accounts to minors seeking to bypass game anti-addiction controls. Police also found nearly one million complete personal records and more than 100 phones at the site.
